source: hand-authored, shaped after Insimul's VESPACE validation-2 findings
note: Each rule targets one scored dimension. `expected` is documentation only — the evaluator never reads it; the committed baseline is the assertion.

rules.name: flatterer_gains_ally
rules.content: rule_applies(flatterer_gains_ally, X, Y) :- female(Y), flattered(Y), affinity(X, Y, V), V > 5, ally(X, Y).
rules.expected: fully reachable — one intrinsic trait plus three action-produced predicates

rules.name: tutored_charisma_rises
rules.content: rule_applies(tutored_charisma_rises, X, Y) :- charming(X), attribute(Y, charisma, V), V < 5, \+ embarrassed(Y).
rules.expected: fully reachable — a negated goal still scores (the predicate must be definable)

rules.name: noble_esteems_spouse
rules.content: rule_applies(noble_esteems_spouse, X, Y) :- noble(X), married(X, Y), esteems(X, Y, V), V > 3.
rules.expected: known-dead married/2 + esteems/3 (the residual dead-key set VESPACE validation 2 §3.4 reports)

rules.name: virtuous_trusts_confidant
rules.content: rule_applies(virtuous_trusts_confidant, X, Y) :- virtuous(X), trusts(X, Y, V), V > 7.
rules.expected: fully dead action slice — trusts/3 is the third residual dead key

rules.name: salon_promotion
rules.content: rule_effect(salon_promotion, C, occupation, salonniere) :- ally(C, celeste_dubois), attribute(C, sophistication, V), V > 6.
rules.expected: non-wrapper (rule_effect/4) head form; a grounded entity reference resolves

rules.name: courts_a_stranger
rules.content: rule_applies(courts_a_stranger, X, Y) :- male(X), affinity(X, marguerite_valmont, V), V > 5.
rules.expected: referential-integrity failure — marguerite_valmont is not in this world

rules.name: trait_prefixed_sentence_rule_about_being_rich_and_old
rules.expected: structural failures — sentence atom, family-prefix predicate, literal actor atom, opaque effect payload (also schema-invalid)
